div.div:
You cannot "expand" an existing subnet. You must create a new, larger subnet and migrate your nodes to it.
Best for: Small clusters that were accidentally started with a tiny /27 or /26 subnet.

Pros: Instantly increases pod density (e.g., 17 pods --> 110 pods on a t3.medium).
Cons: Can cause "fragmentation" if your subnet is already messy.
